passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David loved God.
David praised God in song.
This psalm is a song to God.

passages.text: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to the LORD.
David will sing about the LORD’s loving devotion.
David will sing about the LORD’s justice.
David will sing praises to the LORD.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד־ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

passages.text: I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David seeks to follow God.
David says, "I will think about the way that is blameless."
David asks God, "When will You come to me?"
David says, "I will live in my house with a pure heart."
David chooses to act with integrity.
passages.original: אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה׀ בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתָם־ לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי׃

passages.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David is a servant of God.
David says, "I will not put anything worthless in front of my eyes."
David hates the actions of people who turn away from God.
Their actions will not stick to him.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ אָשִׁ֨ית׀ לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר־ בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה־ סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי׃

passages.text: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
passages.sermon:
I reject a perverse heart.
I will not let a twisted heart stay with me.
I will not know evil.
I will not be familiar with wickedness.
passages.original: לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃

passages.text: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
passages.sermon:
I am the speaker. I am committed to righteousness and integrity.
I will silence anyone who secretly slanders his neighbor.
I will not tolerate anyone with proud eyes.
I will not endure anyone with an arrogant heart.
passages.original: מְלוֹשְׁנִי בַסֵּ֨תֶר׀ רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֪וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ־ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃

passages.text: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
passages.sermon:
I am the speaker in this psalm.
I am a person who seeks to please God.
I look for people who are faithful in the land.
I want faithful people to live with me.
I choose people who walk in the way of integrity.
A person who lives with integrity will serve me.
passages.original: עֵינַ֤י׀ בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי־ אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
passages.sermon:
I do not allow anyone who practices deceit to live in my house.
I do not let anyone who tells lies stand before me.
I reject liars from my presence.
I refuse to let deceivers remain with me.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יֵשֵׁ֨ב׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֪ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹֽא־ יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a ruler who seeks righteousness in his land.
He acts with authority over his people.
Every morning, I will remove all the wicked from the land.
I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
I will not allow those who do evil to remain among God's people.
passages.original: לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כָּל־ רִשְׁעֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵֽעִיר־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
